entities.summary: The Nesher Ramla Homo group are an extinct population of archaic humans who lived during the Middle Pleistocene. In 2010, evidence of a tool industry was discovered during a year of archaeological excavations at the Nesher Ramla site on the outskirts of Ramla in the Central District of Israel. In 2021, the first Nesher Ramla Homo individual was identified from remains discovered during further excavations.
